newsitem.title: UK: T&N gains as report renews bid speculation.
newsitem.headline: T&N gains as report renews bid speculation.

text.p: Shares in T&N Plc rose in early trading on Monday after a weekend report that T&N could attract a takeover bid after rejecting an offer from GKN Plc for its high-technology materials division.
T&N shares were up 3-1/2p at 174 by 0826 GMT while GKN fell 2p to 10.39-1/2 stg.
The Sunday Times said T&N had rejected an approach worth around 250 million stg from GKN for its materials division, highlighting T&N's desire to expand its automotive operations.

The paper said the approach came just after T&N announced a 1.2 billion stg plan to cap its exposure for compensation claims for asbestos-related illnesses. No one at T&N or GKN was immediately available for comment.
